title: EmirAmp
description: EmirAmp adds two new options to zoom in minecraft. One of it Optic Zoom. Other one is Vanilla+ zoom that adds new spyglass type to game.
body:
# **🔍 EmirAmp: Optic & Vanilla+ Zoom**
EmirAmp is a flexible Minecraft utility mod designed to change how you view your world. It bridges the gap between modern, fast-paced magnification features and classic vanilla progression by offering two completely separate operational modes: Direct Zoom and Vanilla+.

You don't need to exit the game or dig through complex config files to switch modes. Simply press the O key while playing to dynamically toggle between Direct Zoom and Vanilla+ mode on the fly! All hotkeys can be reconfigured in your standard in-game Keybindings menu.

## **⚙️ Feature Breakdown**
🔄 Dynamic Mode Swapping
Press the O key at any time during gameplay to instantly switch between Direct Zoom and Vanilla+ modes. A quick and seamless way to change your playstyle depending on your current situation.

###  **1. Direct Zoom Mode**
Designed for players who want immediate, variable magnification without any graphical distractions.

Activation: Press the " key to toggle the zoom state. The mod does not display any vignetting, visual borders, or HUD overlays.

Control: Once activated, simply rotate your mouse scroll wheel forward or backward to smoothly adjust the magnification levels on the fly.

Deactivation: Press the " key once more to instantly turn off the feature and restore your default Field of View (FOV).

### **2. Vanilla+ Mode**
Designed for players who prefer traditional survival immersion but want a stronger late-game alternative to the base tools.

Changes: This mode completely disables the direct keybind zoom option (" key).

Addition: It introduces a brand-new upgrade tier to your survival arsenal: the Diamond Spyglass.

## **💎 Diamond Spyglass Crafting**
The Diamond Spyglass features a highly flexible progression path, allowing you to craft it using either raw materials or by upgrading your existing gear.

### **Method 1: Direct Crafting**
If you are crafting the item from scratch, layout the standard vanilla spyglass setup (Amethyst Shard in the top-center, followed by two vertical Copper Ingots below) and place 4 Diamonds into the remaining upper empty slots of the crafting grid.

### **Method 2: Upgrade Crafting**
If you already possess a standard spyglass and want to upgrade it, place the vanilla Spyglass directly into the center slot of the crafting table and surround it with 4 Diamonds.
